entries.zh: 房间；住所，任意一间房舍
entries.en: room; lodging, any chamber

entries.zh: 房间，居室
entries.en: room, chamber

entries.zh: 房间；（房屋的）一间
entries.en: room; a single chamber (one room of a house)

entries.zh: 后堂，官员接待来客的内厅
entries.en: rear hall; the inner hall where a mandarin receives visitors
entries.notes: 西语 "re sigue la visita" 疑为 "recibe ... la visita" 之讹省，官职语境依 H 後堂 与 M/R 音读定。

entries.zh: 五凤楼（宫殿楼阁；据西语为后妃梳妆之所）
entries.en: the Five-Phoenix Tower, a palace pavilion (per the Spanish, where the queen does her hair)

entries.zh: 深宫（王后与国王相见议事的内室）
entries.en: the inner palace; the queen's private chamber where she speaks with the king

entries.zh: 寅宾馆，接待宾客、候见国王者的馆舍
entries.en: the Yínbīn hall, a reception house for guests awaiting audience with the king
entries.notes: 西语缩写 "r:" 与 "iuen ni li rey" 残损，展开为 "recibe a los que vienen a ver al rey" 系推断；H 寅賓館 本为迎宾候见之所可相证。

entries.zh: 绣房，妇女刺绣做女红的房间；闺房
entries.en: embroidery room; the women's workroom and quarters

entries.zh: 长房，家族中长子这一支；长子的居所
entries.en: the senior branch of a family (the eldest son's line and household); the eldest son's quarters
entries.notes: 西语直译"长子的房间"，而 H 長房 在宗族语境实指长子一支，释义从汉字并存西语表层义。

entries.zh: 赌，赌博下注
entries.en: to bet, to gamble, to wager
entries.notes: M 欄 "Foû" 与本页他条 賭 之 hǔi 不合，疑抄讹；L 与 H 义相符，故义可定而音栏存疑。

entries.zh: 赌过了，已下注
entries.en: to have bet; already wagered

entries.zh: 赌博下注、押注（输则赔付）
entries.en: to stake a bet in a game; to wager and pay out
entries.notes: H 第二字原件 [疑:賠/貯]，依 M/R 之 pō 定为 賠。

entries.zh: 对赌，互相下注
entries.en: to bet against one another; to make a mutual wager

entries.zh: 互赌输赢；互相比输赢、较劲
entries.en: to wager against each other; to vie to see who loses
entries.notes: 相輸 兼有"较劲、比高下"义，西语仅作 apostar，故取互赌义而标注两可。

entries.zh: 互相恫吓、叫阵威胁
entries.en: to threaten or defy one another
entries.notes: 西语 apostar 与 H 相嚇 字面不合，疑取 apostárselas（互相叫阵、较劲）之义方通。

entries.zh: 相帮，彼此帮衬；合伙共下一注
entries.en: to help one another; to join in a common wager
entries.notes: H 第二字原件 [疑:幫/封]，M/R 之 pā̃/pâng 可证为 幫；西语 "Apostaran en uno" 残损，合伙下注义系推断。

entries.zh: 替众人包揽输赢、代众下注（做庄家）
entries.en: to take and hold everyone's bets on the outcome; to act as bookmaker for all
entries.notes: H 首字原件 [疑:幫/憑]，M/R 与 幫 相应；五字与西语 "apostando que cualquiera gana" 仅大致对应，做庄义属推断。

entries.zh: 出谜、猜谜（以猜谜打赌）
entries.en: to make or guess riddles; to bet by guessing a riddle
entries.notes: 西语 "que era novena" 于义不通（疑 novena/nouena 误书），词义依 H 做謎 与 M/R 定。

entries.zh: 生疮脓肿；气血郁结不通（病症）
entries.en: abscessed; suffering from obstruction or blockage (of the humours)
entries.notes: H 作 賬量 且原件 [疑:賬/相]，M/R 无法与 "apostemado, opilado" 之医学义对应，暂依西语词头释义存疑。

entries.zh: 估价，估值
entries.en: to appraise, to value, to estimate

entries.zh: 估价定价；定税则价目（aranzel 兼指关税税则）
entries.en: to appraise and fix a price; to set a tariff or price schedule
entries.notes: aranzel 在马尼拉贸易语境兼指关税税则，故附次要义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H 与 R 两栏皆空，仅存 M 之 pōē cāē，无从复原词义。
